title: Information and Trading Targets in a Dynamic Market Equilibrium
one_line: Theory: a rebalancer splitting orders toward a target and an informed insider produce autocorrelated order flow, U-shaped intraday volume and S-shaped price impact; their orders partly offset each other.

findings.statement: Order flow autocorrelated because of the rebalancer's splitting.
U-shaped expected volume; S-shaped price impact.
